#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n, m, s;
    long long t;
    scanf("%d %d %d %lld", &n, &m, &s, &t);
    s--; // convert to 0-index

    // first while loop: reduce t until t % n == 0
    while (t % n != 0) {
        if (s < m) {
            s = (int)((s + t) % n);
        } else {
            s = (int)((s - t) % n);
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
        t--;
    }
    t /= n;

    int* seen = new int[n];
    std::fill(seen, seen + n, -1);
    seen[s] = 0;
    int count = 0;
    while (t-- > 0) {
        count++;
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            if (s < m) {
                s = (s + i) % n;
            } else {
                s = (s - i + n) % n;
            }
        }
        if (seen[s] != -1) {
            t %= (count - seen[s]);
        }
        seen[s] = count;
    }
    printf("%d\n", s + 1);
    delete[] seen;
    return 0;
}
